title: ConstantSubsheafLowerImageStalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\iota:K\to C$ a monomorphism of abelian sheaves, and $\alpha:C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ an isomorphism to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $n,b\in\mathbb N$, opens $A_i$ and labels $0<c_i\leq b+1$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, and an epimorphism $g:\bigoplus_i j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$ [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Assume that the image $s_i$ of the canonical unit section under the $i$th component of $g$ maps under $\alpha\iota$ to the constant section $c_i$, and that at every point of $U=\bigcup_i A_i$ an active label divides all active labels. Define $f$ on the same coproduct by its $i$th component equal to the $i$th component of $g$ if $c_i\leq b$, and zero otherwise. Put $L=\operatorname{im}(f)$, $l:L\to K$ its canonical inclusion, and $V=\bigcup_{c_i\leq b}A_i$. For arbitrary stalk isomorphisms $e_x:C_x\simeq\mathbb Z$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], the image $e_x\iota_xl_x(L_x)$ has nonnegative generator at most $b$. The stalk of $\operatorname{coker}(l)$ is zero on $V$ and outside $U$. The stalk of $L$ is zero outside $V$.

proof.text: Apply constantSubsheaf_selected_stalk_range to the low predicate c_i <= b. The stalk of factorThruImage f is epimorphic, so factoring f through its image gives the same low-label range. Apply the range theorem with predicate True; surjectivity of the stalk of g gives the full K-stalk range.

Outside V the low generating set is empty. On V choose an active low label j. By hgcd there is an active i dividing every active label; positivity of c_j gives c_i <= c_j <= b. The closure of the low labels and the closure of all labels both equal the multiples of c_i: all labels are multiples, and i itself is in each set. Apply closure_le and zmultiples_le for the two inclusions. Commute integer multiplication to identify these multiples with the displayed scalar-multiplication range. Use generator zero outside V.

On V the full and low ranges coincide by the attained-divisor calculation. Outside U both generating sets are empty, so their ranges also coincide. The stalk of iota followed by e_x is injective, so range equality lifts each K-stalk element through l_x. Thus l_x is surjective. Preserve the cokernel under the stalk functor and use isZero_cokernel_of_epi.
Outside V the low range is zero. The stalk map of l followed by iota and e_x is injective; therefore each L-stalk element is zero. AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton proves the last assertion.
